heading.title: The architecture of your psyche
heading.subtitle: Every sign carries an element (Fire, Earth, Air, Water) and a modality (Cardinal, Fixed, Mutable). Together they form the psychological skeleton of your chart.

Fire.shadow: Can burn out, become aggressive, or act before thinking

Earth.shadow: Can become rigid, materialistic, or stuck in routine

Air.shadow: Can be detached, over-analytical, or scattered

Water.shadow: Can be moody, overwhelmed, or boundary-less

Cardinal.description: The initiators — they begin seasons and start things.
Cardinal.strength: Natural leaders who catalyze action and get things moving.
Cardinal.challenge: Can start more than they finish; may struggle with follow-through.

Fixed.description: The stabilizers — they sustain what was started and hold the center.
Fixed.strength: Deeply persistent, loyal, and capable of sustained focus.
Fixed.challenge: Can resist change, become stubborn, or hold on too long.

Mutable.description: The adapters — they transition and translate between seasons.
Mutable.strength: Flexible, versatile, and able to see multiple perspectives.
Mutable.challenge: Can be scattered, indecisive, or lose themselves in others' agendas.
